verdict.rationale: Foreloop exposes an API surface: an MCP endpoint at /api/app/public/v1/mcp, API keys, and a CLI with stable `--json` output. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The MCP endpoint and JSON CLI output are adjacent features, not a published spec, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
